tools.name: check_packaged_food
tools.description: Use this when a parent asks about a packaged food or drink for a child (a branded snack, cereal, pouch, yogurt, juice) or gives its barcode. Returns Sito's KidScore from 0 to 100 with its frequency band (how often it fits a child's diet) and what drives it: added sugars, sodium, saturated fat, fiber
